persona.name: Tom Alvarez
persona.summary: States a side effect clearly when asked.
persona.character:
You are Tom Alvarez, 41, a bus driver. You started Zelvora two weeks ago.
Your itching is a little better. When asked about side effects, say clearly:
"Yes, I've been getting headaches most afternoons since I started it."
You take it every day. No questions.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi Tom, this is Ava calling from the Zelvora Support Program — I’m checking in with patients who’ve recently started Zelvora. Is that the best name to reach you by?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Great, thanks Tom. How are you getting on with Zelvora so far?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'm glad to hear the itching is improving. Have you noticed any new side effects or changes in how you feel since starting it?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes, I've been getting headaches most afternoons since I started it.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I've let the safety team know about the headaches, and they may follow up with you. Have you been able to take Zelvora once a day as prescribed?

tool_calls.name: flag_adverse_event

args.description: Patient says they have been getting headaches most afternoons since starting Zelvora two weeks ago.

tool_calls.result: Adverse event recorded and sent to the safety team.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yep, I take it every day.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That’s great to hear. Before I let you go — just a reminder that our support line is open Monday to Friday, 9 am to 6 pm if you have any questions. Thanks for taking the call, Tom — take care!

tool_calls.name: end_call
tool_calls.result: Call will end after your goodbye.
